probe_source:
import hashlib,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
import pymupdf
import aspose.words_foss as aw
from tests import test_pdf_bidi_formatting as t
original=t.glyphs
cases={}
for label,parts in [('rtl',('سلام ','(123)',' عالم ','ABC',' نهاية')),('ltr',('START ','سلام ','(123) ','عالم ','END')),('neutral',('سلام ',' - ','ABC',' (123) ','عالم'))]:
 for wrapped in (False,True):
  samples=[]
  def capture(raw):
   glyphs=original(raw)
   with pymupdf.open(stream=raw,filetype='pdf') as doc:
    samples.append({'glyphs':glyphs,'text':''.join(page.get_text() for page in doc),'pages':len(doc),'pixel_sha256':hashlib.sha256(doc[0].get_pixmap(matrix=pymupdf.Matrix(2,2)).samples).hexdigest()})
   return glyphs
  t.glyphs=capture
  try:t.test_format_boundaries_keep_global_bidi_positions(parts,False,wrapped)
  except AssertionError:pass
  same=[x[0] for x in samples[0]['glyphs']]==[x[0] for x in samples[1]['glyphs']]
  delta=max(abs(a-b) for x,y in zip(samples[0]['glyphs'],samples[1]['glyphs']) for a,b in zip(x[1:],y[1:])) if same else None
  cases[f'{label}-{wrapped}']={'same_characters':same,'max_bbox_difference_pt':delta,'samples':samples}
print(json.dumps({'module':aw.__file__,'cases':cases},ensure_ascii=False))
